source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of operators and expressions (PDF 37).

blocks.text: Operators woh nishan (symbols) hain jo variables aur values par koi amal (operation) karte hain, jaise + aur *. Expression variables, operators aur values ka aisa mel hai jo ek nateeja deta hai, jaise 3 + 4 jis ka nateeja 7 hai. Aayiye Python ke mukhtalif operators dekhte hain.

blocks.explanation: Expression: + operator hai, 3 aur 4 qeematein, aur mil kar nateeja 7 dete hain.

items: Operator: amal ka nishan; expression: operators aur values ka mel jo nateeja de.
